updates.title: Authentication retry spike
updates.body: Between 08:10 and 08:24 UTC, login retries increased to four times baseline in the us-east gateway. Mitigation switched traffic to a reduced-latency token verifier path and restored normal response rates. Continue monitoring for repeated spikes during peak handoff windows.

updates.title: Delayed queue drain
updates.body: The notification queue in eu-central reached a backlog of twelve thousand jobs after a rolling restart. Workers have recovered and queue depth is now trending down with an estimated full drain in thirty minutes. No message loss was detected in checkpoint logs.

updates.title: Nightly digest jitter
updates.body: A subset of nightly digest emails were emitted five to seven minutes late due to a stale scheduler lease. The lease rotation patch has been applied and next run checks are already scheduled. Customer impact is limited to delivery timing only.
